title: Combination dial
description: A pixel combination lock with three dials from 0 to 9, up and down buttons on each dial that wrap around, an Open button that succeeds for 3-7-2, and a counter of failed attempts.

title: Basketball scoreboard
description: A pixel scoreboard for two teams: +1, +2 and +3 buttons per team, an undo button that reverts the last score change, a period counter from 1 to 4 and a Reset game button.

title: Change calculator
description: A pixel change calculator: enter the price and the amount paid, show the change and the fewest coins and notes for it using 20, 10, 5, 2, 1, 0.50, 0.20, 0.10 and 0.05.

title: Robot commands
description: A pixel robot on a 5x5 grid starting at the top-left facing right: buttons Forward, Turn left and Turn right, the robot cannot leave the grid, show its position and direction, and a Reset button.

title: RPN calculator
description: A pixel reverse-Polish calculator: number keys and Enter push numbers onto a visible stack, + - × ÷ pop two values and push the result, show an error for too few values, and Clear empties the stack.

title: Ticket queue
description: A pixel ticket counter: Take ticket gives the next number, Serve next calls the lowest waiting number, show the number now serving, the list of waiting numbers and how many are waiting.

title: Days between dates
description: A pixel date calculator: pick two dates and show the number of days between them, the number of full weeks, and whether the second date is before or after the first.

title: Shop inventory
description: A pixel shop inventory of 5 built-in items with stock counts: Sell decreases stock and adds to today's sales total at each item's price, Restock adds 10, items at 0 show 'Sold out' and cannot be sold.
